title: GNANESWARKOKKIRALA/Ai-RAG-Chatbot
summary: Ai-RAG-Chatbot是一个结合了检索增强生成（RAG）和语义搜索的ChromaDB，以及通过Groq API使用LLaMA 3.3 70B模型的智能问答系统。它允许用户上传文档并快速获得准确答案，适用于需要高效文档检索和AI推理的场景。
description: Ai-Rag-Chatbot is an intelligent question-answering system that lets users upload documents and get instant, accurate answers. It combines Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with ChromaDB for semantic search and LLaMA 3.3 70B via Groq API for AI-powered responses .
